lastCompletedStory.title: Write and consume a durable implement-blocked marker

nextStoryContext: src/supervisor/implement-blocked-marker.ts (IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_FILENAME = '.cam-implement-blocked.json') mirrors the ship-stalled/plan-escalated marker precedent verbatim: read/write/remove, never throw, ImplementBlockedMarker { issueId: string; story: string | null; reason: string; writtenAt: string }. WRITE seam: finishTerminal (runSupervisor, loop.ts) calls opts.writeImplementBlockedMarkerFn ONLY when status === 'blocked' AND a mutable lastIssueNumber (set right after every successful readPrd(), since finishTerminal is declared before the per-iteration prd read) is defined -- issueId is String(prd.issueNumber), NOT a backlog issue-id string like the ship-stalled marker's issueId. story is lastIterProgress.currentStoryId ?? null; reason falls back to lastOutcome?.detail ?? TERMINAL_REASON.blocked when no worker outcome was ever set (prd-unreadable, blocked-no-implementable). host.ts's buildSupervisorOptions wires the production writeImplementBlockedMarkerFn (stamps writtenAt, persists via writeImplementBlockedMarker). CONSUME seam: sidecar.ts's makeProductionRearmImplementingFn calls the new exported clearImplementBlockedMarkerForCurrentIssue(markerPath, prdPath) right after a successful rearm (setPhase('implementing')) -- re-arming IS 'the next implement dispatch for that issue' per this story's AC2. That helper reads the marker, reads the CURRENT prd.json's issueNumber, and removes the marker ONLY when it matches (stringified) or when the current prd is unreadable (best-effort, nothing to compare); a marker for a DIFFERENT issueId is left untouched. US-006 (next, unblocked, priority 6) is templates-only: add a .cam-implement-blocked.json boot-read entry to templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md's numbered marker list (~121-136, mirroring the ship-stalled/plan-escalated/plan-preflight entries already there) plus an opening-blocker snippet near ~153, then bun run embed-vendor + embed-vendor:check in the SAME commit (byte-parity gate). This story (US-005) deliberately did NOT touch templates/ (explicitly out of scope per its own notes) -- US-006 owns that half entirely. US-007 (priority 7, requires US-003 only, independent of US-005/US-006) remains the other open story in this PRD.
